The Development

Built for how life actually happens

Dakota Homes is a nine-residence new-construction community by Westerly, set on a quiet stretch of 30th Ave S and S Dakota St in Seattle. Each home is designed as part of an intimate collection — private, well-proportioned, and finished with an eye for craft.

Whether you're drawn to a corner lot or a home tucked deeper into the site, every residence shares the same commitment to quality construction and timeless design.
